title: 1901, July 4 The day of the official bridge opening
description: This rare photograph was discovered hidden behind another picture in an antique frame purchased at a second-hand shop in Nova Scotia by Greg Britton, who grew up in Hartland. He originally bought the frame but was delighted to find an image capturing the opening day of the Hartland Bridge, taken from the Somerville side. The photograph is high-resolution, and when zoomed in, the vibrant activities of July 4, 1901, are clearly visible, as marked on the back. (Photo courtesy of Greg Britton)
